final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT major.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count FROM income JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.department), shares AS (SELECT income_count, CAST(income_count AS REAL) / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(income_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - value) FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE share > value
